issues.issue: Did the RAD err in analyzing fear of persecution after concluding Article 1E applies and in its analysis of fear in South Africa?
issues.applicant_position: RAD erred by analyzing fear of persecution after concluding Article 1E applies and in its analysis of fear in South Africa.
issues.respondent_position: RAD reasonably analyzed fear of South Africa to determine Article 1E referral and exclusion under section 98, meeting Convention objectives.
issues.result_text: RAD's analysis rests on erroneous legal foundation; decision is unreasonable and judicial review is allowed.

issues.issue: Is it permissible under section 98 and the Refugee Convention to consider fear of the country of residence after Article 1E referral and exclusion?
issues.applicant_position: Not stated explicitly, but challenges RAD's consideration of fear of country of residence after Article 1E referral and exclusion.
issues.respondent_position: Parties say RPD and RAD may consider fear of country of residence before Article 1E referral and exclusion under section 98; approach meets Convention objectives.
issues.result_text: Section 98 forbids considering fear of country of residence after Article 1E referral and exclusion; RAD's reasoning was erroneous and cannot be upheld.
